patterns.note: The site utilizes a dark, immersive full-bleed background that allows vibrant imagery and accent colors to stand out prominently.
Section headings are consistently large, bold, and sans-serif, often paired with smaller, uppercase, light-grey labels for clear categorization.
A high-contrast color scheme is used, featuring a dominant black background, white text, and a vibrant orange-red as the primary accent and call-to-action color.
The hero section features a dynamic tiled image background that subtly parallaxes as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth behind the static headline.
Content sections throughout the page appear to fade in and slide up from the bottom as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth reveal effect.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections, each introduced by a subtle uppercase label followed by a prominent heading, guiding the user through the narrative.

technique_notes: The site uses a deep black background with high-contrast white typography and vibrant, saturated imagery to create a sophisticated and impactful visual experience.
Content sections are designed to animate into view with a subtle fade and upward slide as they become visible in the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging scroll experience.
The hero background employs a parallax scrolling effect where the tiled imagery moves at a slower rate than the foreground content, enhancing visual depth and engagement.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold headings (~4-5x body) are used for primary titles, complemented by smaller, often uppercase, supporting labels (~0.75x body).
design_tokens.radius: subtle; elements like buttons and input fields have a very slight corner curve.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy; sections have generous vertical padding, while content grids maintain a breathable but structured density.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dynamic, tiled image collage as a hero background, combined with a bold, almost brutalist typographic treatment for the brand name in the footer, creates a powerful and memorable visual identity. The consistent use of a deep black background allows the vibrant imagery and strong orange accent to pop, giving it a unique, high-energy feel.
